## 5. TRAPS FOR THIS SESSION (each burned at least once)

`?nosw=1` every URL · wait `ready` not `in-world` · fresh `--user-data-dir` per
A/B arm (shader cache) · `renderer.info.autoReset=false` before counting ·
never `pkill -f PAT` with PAT in your own cmdline (exit 144, 3× this session) ·
`rg -rn`/`-rln` is --replace, use plain `-n` (2×) · serve.py re-points the
root `dist` symlink to DEFAULT_ROOT on every start — change the CONSTANT, and
the client fetches `/dist/` (root symlink), NOT `apps/holtburger-web/dist` ·
basisu `-unpack` PNGs: use `_unpacked_rgba_BC7_RGBA_level_0_`, the `_a_` files
are the alpha plane (pure white on opaque art) · session tools go in durable
dirs, never /tmp scratchpads (bc7cli died that way TWICE).
